WITH race_name_totals AS (
  SELECT races.name, SUM(CAST(results.points AS REAL)) AS total_points
  FROM races
  JOIN results ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  GROUP BY races.name
), above_average AS (
  SELECT name, total_points
  FROM race_name_totals
  WHERE total_points > (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)
), selected_results AS (
  SELECT results.points, CAST(results.laps AS REAL) AS laps
  FROM races
  JOIN results ON results.raceId = races.raceId
  JOIN above_average ON above_average.name = races.name
)
SELECT
  (SELECT SUM(total_points) FROM above_average) AS combined_total_points,
  AVG(laps) AS average_laps_completed,
  (SELECT AVG(total_points - (SELECT AVG(total_points) FROM race_name_totals)) FROM above_average) AS average_excess_over_average_total
FROM selected_results;
